# Official nuImages semantic category names; IDs are generated by its devkit rules.
# Foreground IDs 1..23 alphabetically, driveable_surface=24, ego=31.
# Class 0 is unlabeled; IDs 25..30 are unused. Ego is ignored by default.
animal = animal
human.pedestrian.adult = adult person
human.pedestrian.child = child
human.pedestrian.construction_worker = construction worker
human.pedestrian.personal_mobility = person on a scooter | person on a skateboard
human.pedestrian.police_officer = police officer
human.pedestrian.stroller = stroller
human.pedestrian.wheelchair = wheelchair
movable_object.barrier = road barrier
movable_object.debris = debris
movable_object.pushable_pullable = garbage bin | shopping cart | wheelbarrow
movable_object.trafficcone = traffic cone
static_object.bicycle_rack = bicycle rack
vehicle.bicycle = bicycle
vehicle.bus.bendy = articulated bus
vehicle.bus.rigid = bus
vehicle.car = car
vehicle.construction = construction vehicle
vehicle.emergency.ambulance = ambulance
vehicle.emergency.police = police vehicle
vehicle.motorcycle = motorcycle
vehicle.trailer = trailer
vehicle.truck = truck
flat.driveable_surface = road
vehicle.ego = ego vehicle
